topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Heard about the tree they took from ya, the one you planted when you was just a young’un. Must feel strange, seein' the spot where it stood, now empty. Trees, they grow and they give, like the land itself. But sometimes, the axe has to fall, whether for the good of the field or the need of the wood. It’s the way of things, the turning of the seasons. Maybe, when the time’s right, you could plant another. A new start, a new tree to watch over the years, just like you did before. The saints know, life goes on, and so does the earth.
